nodes.label: D49: iOS 26 selection lens (GlassLens)
nodes.decision: The iOS 26 selection lens on every control with a sliding selection that the app draws itself: the segmented control (Explore Workshops / 1:1 lessons, Book session type, Bookings Upcoming / Past) and the floating `TabBar` (Android, Gallery). One shared `useGlassLens` + `GlassLens` (`ui/GlassLens.tsx`): touching swells the lens and moves it under the finger, a drag carries it across (stretching as it travels), letting go springs it onto that segment and selects it; a scroll that starts on the track lets it fall back. The resting thumb fades to interactive glass while touched on native Liquid Glass. Spring values are tokens (`motion.lens*`, provisional, tuned by eye). Reduce Motion: no swell or stretch. Fonts and icons unchanged. Buttons, icon buttons and the nav cluster already use the system's interactive glass (D44), and Apple's own tab bar animates itself (D47)
